releases.title: WanderTrace 2.4.2 — Step timing and delivery fixes
releases.commit_message:
fix(steps): correct timing and sensor event delivery for 2.4.2

Integrate full elapsed time, timestamp individual steps, retry queued writes,
and report native patch state and transport counters. Add portable timing
and queue checks, socket regressions, and documented coverage limitations.

releases.title: WanderTrace 2.4.3 — Pace preview and motion variation
releases.commit_message:
feat(motion): add pace preview and session-based variation for 2.4.3

Show live min/km pace and reference bounds; replace the repeated speed
table with session-seeded linear variation and exact distance integration.
Add continuous bounded GPS drift, compatibility checks for saved settings,
and owner-operated source/release publication scripts with versioned notes.
